text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly a systematic review and meta-analysis of power densities across energy types in the U.S., synthesizing 177 estimates from 54 publications. While it applies these density values to NREL future energy scenarios to assess land-use implications, its primary purpose is not to conduct original LULC prediction modeling but to review and standardize spatial metrics (power density) used in energy system analyses. It touches on land use implications of renewable energy deployment and uses future scenarios that involve land-use change, thus qualifying as a REVIEW that addresses land use/land cover considerations in future energy transitions.)
